title: 3EN block-unblock integration test
description: Large reversible integration test for the manual blocking path. Uses reserved documentation IP 203.0.113.77 only. Captures the current en3_block4 state, inserts the test IP into the runtime nft set, verifies membership and rule references, removes it, verifies cleanup, checks that the original set remains intact, captures relevant logs/counters, and inventories likely local 3EN GUI/runtime artifacts on Windows without modifying them.
backup:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $Key=Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.ssh\3en002_agent_ed25519'; $ssh=(Get-Command ssh.exe -ErrorAction Stop).Source; $remote=@'
set -e
B=/root/3en-backup-015
rm -rf "$B"
mkdir -p "$B"
nft list set inet fw4 en3_block4 > "$B/en3_block4.before.txt"
nft list ruleset | grep -n -C 2 'en3_block4' > "$B/en3_rules.before.txt" || true
echo BACKUP_015_OK
'@; $remote | & $ssh -i $Key -o BatchMode=yes -o IdentitiesOnly=yes -o ConnectTimeout=8 root@192.168.1.2 'sh -s' 2>&1 | ForEach-Object {Write-Host $_}; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw '015 backup failed'}
script:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $TestIp='203.0.113.77'; $Key=Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.ssh\3en002_agent_ed25519'; $ssh=(Get-Command ssh.exe -ErrorAction Stop).Source; Write-Host '=== 3EN BLOCK/UNBLOCK INTEGRATION TEST 015 ==='; Write-Host ('TEST_IP='+$TestIp); $remote=@'
set -e
T=203.0.113.77
echo '=== BEFORE ==='
nft list set inet fw4 en3_block4
echo
echo '=== ADD TEST IP ==='
nft add element inet fw4 en3_block4 { $T }
nft list set inet fw4 en3_block4 | grep -F "$T"
echo BLOCK_ADD=PASS
echo
echo '=== RULE REFERENCES ==='
nft list ruleset | grep -n -C 2 'en3_block4' || true
echo
echo '=== COUNTERS BEFORE CLEANUP ==='
nft list ruleset | grep -A 12 'chain en3_security_pre_input' || true
echo
echo '=== REMOVE TEST IP ==='
nft delete element inet fw4 en3_block4 { $T }
if nft list set inet fw4 en3_block4 | grep -Fq "$T"; then echo BLOCK_REMOVE=FAIL; exit 41; else echo BLOCK_REMOVE=PASS; fi
echo
echo '=== AFTER ==='
nft list set inet fw4 en3_block4
echo
echo '=== RECENT 3EN LOGS ==='
logread -l 300 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei '3en blocked|manual|block|unblock' | tail -n 120 || true
echo
echo TEST_015_ROUTER=PASS
'@; $remote | & $ssh -i $Key -o BatchMode=yes -o IdentitiesOnly=yes -o ConnectTimeout=8 root@192.168.1.2 'sh -s' 2>&1 | ForEach-Object {Write-Host $_}; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw '015 router integration test failed'}; Write-Host ''; Write-Host '=== WINDOWS 3EN ARTIFACT INVENTORY ==='; $roots=@('C:\3EN-Agent','E:\skrypty'); foreach($root in $roots){ if(Test-Path $root){ Write-Host ('--- ROOT '+$root+' ---'); Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $root -File -Recurse -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Name -match '3en|threat|block|security|monitor' } | Select-Object -First 120 FullName,Length,LastWriteTime | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 240 | Write-Host } }; Write-Host ''; Write-Host '=== RUNNING 3EN-LIKE PROCESSES ==='; Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Name -match 'python|powershell|pwsh|3en' -and $_.CommandLine -match '3en|threat|security|monitor' } | Select-Object ProcessId,Name,CommandLine | Format-List | Out-String -Width 300 | Write-Host; Write-Host 'TEST_015_WINDOWS=PASS'
test:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $Key=Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.ssh\3en002_agent_ed25519'; $ssh=(Get-Command ssh.exe -ErrorAction Stop).Source; $out=& $ssh -i $Key -o BatchMode=yes -o IdentitiesOnly=yes -o ConnectTimeout=8 root@192.168.1.2 "nft list set inet fw4 en3_block4; echo FINAL_CHECK" 2>&1; $out | ForEach-Object {Write-Host $_}; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw '015 final SSH check failed'}; if(($out -join '
') -match '203\.0\.113\.77'){throw '015 cleanup failed: test IP still blocked'}; foreach($ip in '5.253.84.77','79.124.62.126','79.124.62.134','79.124.62.230','204.76.203.4'){ if(($out -join '
') -notmatch [regex]::Escape($ip)){throw ('015 original set member missing: '+$ip)} }; Write-Host 'VALIDATION_015=PASS'
rollback:
$ErrorActionPreference='Continue'; $Key=Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.ssh\3en002_agent_ed25519'; $ssh=(Get-Command ssh.exe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Source; if(-not $ssh){Write-Host 'ROLLBACK ERROR: ssh.exe missing'; return}; $remote=@'
T=203.0.113.77
nft delete element inet fw4 en3_block4 { $T } 2>/dev/null || true
echo ROLLBACK_015_TEST_IP_REMOVED
nft list set inet fw4 en3_block4 2>/dev/null || true
'@; $remote | & $ssh -i $Key -o BatchMode=yes -o IdentitiesOnly=yes -o ConnectTimeout=8 root@192.168.1.2 'sh -s' 2>&1 | ForEach-Object {Write-Host $_}; Write-Host ('ROLLBACK_SSH_EXIT='+$LASTEXITCODE)
